# Edwin Trigos | Software Architect & Full Stack Developer

> Portfolio of Edwin Trigos — Software Architect and Full Stack Developer specializing in .NET, Clean Architecture, and financial systems. 5+ years building production systems. Bilingual technical blog (ES/EN). Remote from Bucaramanga, Colombia.

Technologies: .NET 8+, C#, SQL Server, Dapper, Clean Architecture, React 19, TypeScript, PHP/Laravel, AWS, Flutter, Docker, Java/Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Azure, Cloudflare Workers, IndexedDB, Playwright, Vitest.

## Blog — Technical Architecture Articles

### El atributo de autorización que ninguna prueba unitaria puede ver
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#/blog/article/atributo-autorizacion-invisible-prueba-unitaria

**Published**: 2026-09-26 | **Language**: ES/EN | **English title**: The Authorization Attribute a Unit Test Cannot See

I added an administrative endpoint that replaces an operation only a DBA could previously run, protected by an authorization attribute. The obvious unit test confirmed it green by calling the controller method directly, which is exactly why it proved nothing: that attribute is only ever evaluated by the middleware, never by a bare method call. The honest test needed a real test server and a deliberate mutation of the attribute to prove it measured what it claimed to measure.

I built an interactive desktop inside a portfolio whose other theme may not move a single pixel, using two committed Playwright drivers: a behaviour harness grown red-first to 98 checks, and a pixel gate. Writing tests against a committed driver was not the finish line — the gate had been passing every failure for months.

### Una interfaz uniforme no arregla una asimetría semántica
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#/blog/article/interfaz-uniforme-no-arregla-asimetria-semantica

**Published**: 2026-09-12 | **Language**: ES/EN | **English title**: A Uniform Interface Does Not Fix a Semantic Asymmetry

Two external risk-data providers, one refactor that looked obvious, and a uniform interface to unify them. One provider returns a decision; the other returns variables and carries no viability field at all. The interface makes both shapes compile — it does not create the missing datum. Here is how I separated what could genuinely be unified from what had to fail out loud.

### Audio multiplataforma en Flutter: dos engines, una API, tres plataformas
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#/blog/article/audio-multiplataforma-flutter-arquitectura

**Published**: 2026-06-26 | **Language**: ES/EN | **English title**: Cross-platform audio in Flutter: two engines, one API, three platforms

There is no single Flutter audio engine that covers Android, Windows, and Linux with the same quality. The solution is not to choose one: it is to compose. just_audio as the unified API, media_kit as the desktop backend, audio_service for lifecycle and notification, SMTC for media keys on Windows. Here is the real architecture, the platform-specific offsets, and the bugs that only appear on desktop.

### Cuando tu app depende de una API que no controlas: reverse-engineering YouTube Music
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#/blog/article/youtube-innertube-api-resiliencia

Harmony-Music does not use the official YouTube API. It uses InnerTube, the internal API that YouTube Music exposes to its own web app, reverse-engineered for years. When YouTube changes the response format (no changelog, no docs, no warning), 24 of 25 search results fall into orphan buckets. Here is the story of rewriting the bucketing, classifying by pageType, and building a ResponseRecorder for offline diff.

### Audio en background en Android 14+ cuando heredaste código de Android 9
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#/blog/article/android-14-audio-background-modernizacion

**Published**: 2026-06-26 | **Language**: ES/EN | **English title**: Background audio on Android 14+ when you inherited Android 9 code

A music app you inherited with Android 9 code has three problems running on Android 14+: scoped storage killed Permission.storage, foreground service types are strict, and any native API (like the equalizer) needs a JNI bridge because there is no Dart package. Here is the complete solution: SDK-version-aware permissions, JNI for Equalizer, and the audio_service config that keeps the music alive in background.

## Case Studies — Production Systems

### STARSOL — SaaS Platform for Integrated Risk Management
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects
**Period**: 2024-Present | **Role**: Cloud Software Architect & Independent Developer
**Stack**: PHP, Laravel, AWS, .NET MAUI, MySQL, Docker, CI/CD

B2B SaaS platform for the solidarity sector covering SARLAFT, SARC, and SIAR risk management. Async architecture with 3 background workers processing jobs simultaneously, decoupling file uploads from the main web server thread. .NET MAUI client app with offline sync. AWS high-availability infrastructure with CI/CD pipelines.

### LOS — Loan Origination System
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects
**Period**: 2025-2026 | **Role**: Software Architect / Full Stack Developer
**Stack**: .NET 8+, C#, Dapper, SQL Server, Clean Architecture, REST API, JWT, Strategy Pattern

Complete loan origination system built from scratch. Data layer: DDL with 4 logical schemas (cfg/cat/fab/aud), 30+ tables, 23-state state machine, 27 stored procedures. Service layer: REST API with Clean Architecture — repositories per schema, services per domain, controllers per channel (Admin/Store/Web/Handoff). Identity verification via voice bot with catalog-driven decision engine. Biometric fraud detection. INSERT-ONLY audit trail.

**Impact**: 114+ API endpoints across 6 BFF layers (Admin/Core/Store/Web/Handoff/Util). 27 stored procedures in production. 23-state loan lifecycle with full traceability. Automated identity verification via voice bot with manual Plan B as a first-class citizen. Immutable audit trail of all operations. 474/474 tests green after making the risk-data provider configurable, delivered as 3 chained PRs. I then redesigned the operator's case workspace so every action gets its own dialog instead of sharing a generic one, delivered as 10 chained commits of at most 400 lines each and closed with 23 requirements and 117 verified scenarios. An administrative endpoint replaced an operation only a DBA could previously run, delivered as 3 chained PRs, with its guarding permission proven through the real HTTP pipeline rather than a direct method call.

### SOVI — Identity Validation Orchestrator
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects
**Period**: 2026 | **Role**: Software Architect
**Stack**: .NET, C#, SQL Server, Strategy Pattern, REST API

Strategy pattern with two validation strategies: BotValidacionStrategy (voice bot) and ManualValidacionStrategy (human advisor). Catalog-driven decision engine — no hardcoded if/switch. Each bot diagnosis triggers a SystemAction from database catalog. Complete traceability per study with 10+ categorized bot diagnoses.

### Datacredito API Integration
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects
**Period**: 2024-2025 | **Role**: Backend Developer
**Stack**: .NET 8, C#, Dapper, SQL Server, Polly, Serilog, JWT, REST API

Credit bureau REST API with resilience patterns (Polly circuit breaker + retry policy). JWT authentication. Structured logging with Serilog. Request/response logging middleware with sensitive field sanitization. Query times reduced from 3s to 400ms through index optimization.

### Payroll System — ERP Document Generation for Franchise Chain
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects
**Period**: 2025-2026 | **Role**: Full Stack Developer
**Stack**: C#, .NET Framework, Crystal Reports, SQL Server, ERP

Extended CRM document routing for 3 new franchise-chain payroll types. Modified dynamic routing logic, added 21 .rpt templates organized by payroll type. Non-invasive extension — zero breaks in 45+ legacy payroll types.

### Admin Module UI Architecture
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects
**Period**: 2026 | **Role**: Frontend Architect
**Stack**: React, TypeScript, REST API, UI Architecture

Restructured admin module into two macro-modules: "Panel de Control" (monitoring dashboard) and "Módulo Administrar" (CRUD configuration with tabs). Navigation reflects clean backend architecture. Scalable — new capabilities require only a new tab in the corresponding macro-module.

### Portfolio — Hybrid Architecture
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects
**Period**: 2026-Present | **Role**: Frontend Developer & Designer
**Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, GitHub API, Playwright

Designed a hybrid architecture: curated content layer (STAR-format case studies in TypeScript, work experience, blog) as the primary source of truth, and GitHub API as a secondary activity widget. Implemented native i18n (ES/EN), pixel-art editorial design system with pixel shadows and newspaper typography, and Framer Motion animations. Built with React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4. On top of that I added a second theme selected through `data-theme` —from the editorial newspaper to an interactive XP-style desktop— driven by a WindowManager that owns every rect, clamp and z-order: draggable windows, 8-handle resizing, a Start menu, a taskbar with a utilities tray, tabs inside a single window, and a Help window kept out of the visible registry. I also treated visibility to AI engines as measurable engineering: JSON-LD structured data plus `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt`, which took an automated GEO audit from 58 to 83/100.

**Impact**: Architecture that prioritizes business impact over source code. NDA-compliant case studies without exposing confidential information. Native i18n without external libraries. Custom design system that visually stands out from generic portfolios. Adding a case study = 1 TypeScript object. The XP desktop was built with strict TDD against a committed Playwright driver —98/98 checks, RED before GREEN on every work unit— and a second committed driver pixel-diffs the newspaper theme across 4 viewports × 2 locales against committed baselines: it demands 0 differing pixels, so the editorial design cannot drift while the second theme evolves.

### Centralized Email Communications API — Single Provider
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects
**Period**: 2024 | **Role**: Backend Architect / API Designer
**Stack**: .NET 8, C#, Clean Architecture, Dapper, SQL Server, Serilog, Polly, Azure Blob Storage, JWT

**Problem**: 5 independent email sending silos, each system calling the provider directly with its own credentials, retry logic and format. Diagnosing an undelivered email took 30 minutes across 5 servers and 8 mailboxes. Zero cross-system traceability.

**Solution**: One REST API in .NET 8 with Clean Architecture in 4 layers (Api / Application / Domain / Infrastructure). A provider-agnostic IEmailProvider interface in Domain; an application service that validates, applies per-context templates with typed tokens, persists each transaction with its own GUID before calling the provider, and retries with exponential backoff; a typed HttpClient adapter with Polly circuit breaker in Infrastructure. 8 multi-tenant accounts resolved by business context from configuration. Serilog with 3 pipelines and sanitization of attachments, PII and credentials.

**Impact**: Diagnosis time for an undelivered email from 30 minutes to 5 seconds. Zero hardcoded credentials, rotatable without redeploy. Provider change measured in hours, not weeks. Zero orphan emails. 7 REST controllers (one per consumption channel) sharing the same application service.

### Harmony-Music — Cross-Platform Flutter Open Source Music App
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects
**Period**: 2026-Present | **Role**: Open Source Maintainer & Flutter Developer
**Stack**: Flutter 3.44+, Dart, GetX, just_audio, media_kit, audio_service, youtube_explode_dart, Hive, Dio, JNI

**Problem**: The original creator marked the repository as "unmaintained" in December 2025: abandoned dependencies, leftover Gradle migrator flags, runtime crashes (RangeError from indexWhere returning -1), no debugging tools, and an undocumented API (YouTube Music InnerTube) that changed without notice and broke search.

**Solution**: 4-phase triage. (1) Build first — Gradle 8.14, AGP 8.11.1, Kotlin 2.2.20 with modern DSL. (2) Deprecations — 19 commits replacing deprecated Flutter/Material APIs and removing dead packages. (3) Runtime — rewrote search bucketing for the new flat InnerTube format, added indexWhere guards, structured HTTP logging. (4) Tooling — a ResponseRecorder that captures raw responses to disk for offline diffing. Audio via just_audio + media_kit + audio_service + SMTC on 3 platforms with a single Dart API.

**Impact**: ~36 commits in 3 days from "does not compile" to release v1.12.2 with a modern toolchain. Working search with the new InnerTube format. Clean build on Flutter 3.44+. Audio on 3 platforms. Complete documentation, releases and changelog.

### ReaderSS — RSS Reader with Offline Reading and an Edge Relay
https://ewin24.github.io/portfolio/#projects
**Period**: 2026 | **Role**: Architect & Full Stack Developer
**Stack**: TypeScript, Preact, Vite, IndexedDB, Cloudflare Workers, DOMPurify, Vitest, GitHub Actions

**Problem**: Browsers dropped native RSS support; surviving readers are cloud services that keep your feed list. A browser page cannot fetch an arbitrary feed (CORS), and none of it works offline.

**Solution**: Domain, ports and adapters behind a composition root with IndexedDB as the data layer. A Cloudflare Workers relay solves CORS and adds conditional GET, size and time limits, an SSRF guard re-applied on every redirect hop, and an explicitly non-authenticating origin guard. Parsers for RSS 2.0, RDF, Atom and JSON Feed normalize onto one entry model; DOMPurify sanitisation at a single choke point. OPML import/export, read/unread/starred state with per-field timestamps, per-feed failure reporting.

**Impact**: 426 tests at ~95% statement coverage against an enforced 70% gate. 248 kB raw bundle, 88 kB gzipped. GitHub Actions runs lint, typecheck and tests before deploying to Cloudflare Workers. Public MIT-licensed repository.
